install:
curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh
bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 8.0
echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet' >> $HOME/.bashrc
echo 'export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools' >> $HOME/.bashrc
export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet
export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools
dotnet --info
dotnet restore
dotnet build --no-restore -c Release

terminals.name: portfolio
terminals.command: export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet; export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools; dotnet run --urls http://0.0.0.0:45217
